summary: Frontend-only testing of redesigned testimonials section on Home page at both desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) breakpoints. All acceptance criteria met.

desktop_1440x900.all_8_names_found: Sharon S, Allison Bissell, Bill Vincent, Kerri Pfuehler, Sophie Schmitz, Candice Eldred, Lindsey, Juli James (PASS)
desktop_1440x900.regression: hero h1 present, 4 program tiles, map iframe present, instagram grid visible in screenshot

mobile_390x844.dot_3_click: dot-3 becomes active (w-6 bg-lime), dot-0 becomes inactive (w-2 bg-white/25) (PASS)

test_results.console_errors: Only harmless 401 on /api/auth/me as noted in request. No pageerrors.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: scroll handler in MobileTestimonials could debounce or use IntersectionObserver for smoother active state, but current implementation works.
Minor: TESTIMONIALS mapped by t.name as key — if two testimonials ever share a name it will collide. Consider stable id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testimonials redesign verified end-to-end. Desktop grid uses `hidden md:grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` — at md (768-1023) that would be 2 cols x 4 rows; only at lg+ do you get the requested 2 rows x 4 cols. Tested at 1440 (lg) which shows 2x4 correctly.
